synth.notes:
Blocks move together on a 4-grid: A1/A2 = y-/+4, A3 = apart, A4 = together; each block is blocked by bounds [2,58], invisible maze cells, marker cells and the other block.
Clicking an inactive marker arms it (blocks -> color_1 players, marker -> color_11) and A1-A4 then move it. Clicking the active marker or a block does nothing; clicking a player switches back to blocks.
Marker ACTION6 no_change vs gone comes from where the click lands: on the already-active marker it is a no-op; gone is just the (y,x) name re-ranking on arm/switch.
The timer bars have w = 3(a+1)//7. The action count a is hidden and kept only while states match; otherwise it falls back to ceil(7w/3). Names re-rank by (y,x).
Not confirmed: the maze cells (14,38),(6,18),(38,14),(22,18) are inferred from blocked moves only. (22,18) explains step 124 (without it only that step fails), and other maze cells were never seen.
